components.name: Refresh Button
components.description: The single high-emphasis action that starts ingest and reconciliation.
components.css: :host { --ds-primary:#1d5fd1; --ds-primary-fg:#fff; --ds-focus:#8eb0f0; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-primary:#7db2ff; --ds-primary-fg:#101318; --ds-focus:#7db2ff; } } .ds-refresh { min-height:36px; padding:8px 14px; border:0; border-radius:6px; background:var(--ds-primary); color:var(--ds-primary-fg); font:500 14px/1 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:filter 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-refresh:hover { filter:brightness(.92); } .ds-refresh:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus); outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-refresh { transition:none; } }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: A low-emphasis action for theme and secondary navigation.
components.css: :host { --ds-surface:#fff; --ds-ink:#18212f; --ds-border:#cbd3dd; --ds-hover:#eef1f5; --ds-focus:#1d5fd1; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-surface:#171c23; --ds-ink:#edf2f7; --ds-border:#3b4654; --ds-hover:#232a34; --ds-focus:#7db2ff; } } .ds-ghost { min-height:36px; padding:8px 12px; border:1px solid var(--ds-border); border-radius:6px; background:var(--ds-surface); color:var(--ds-ink); font:500 14px/1 system-ui,sans-serif; transition:background 180ms cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1); } .ds-ghost:hover { background:var(--ds-hover); } .ds-ghost:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus); outline-offset:2px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-ghost { transition:none; } }

components.name: Evidence Search
components.description: A native search field for exact evidence IDs and public task references.
components.css: :host { --ds-surface:#fff; --ds-ink:#18212f; --ds-border:#cbd3dd; --ds-focus:#1d5fd1; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-surface:#171c23; --ds-ink:#edf2f7; --ds-border:#3b4654; --ds-focus:#7db2ff; } } .ds-field { display:grid; gap:6px; color:var(--ds-ink); font:500 13px/1.25 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-input { min-height:36px; padding:8px 10px; border:1px solid var(--ds-border); border-radius:6px; background:var(--ds-surface); color:var(--ds-ink); font:400 14px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus); outline-offset:1px; border-color:var(--ds-focus); }

components.name: Project Navigation
components.description: A quiet current-project row in the desktop rail.
components.html: HydraMalena LMS
components.css: :host { --ds-ink:#18212f; --ds-muted:#526071; --ds-hover:#eef1f5; --ds-selected:#dce9ff; --ds-focus:#1d5fd1; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-ink:#edf2f7; --ds-muted:#b6c0cc; --ds-hover:#232a34; --ds-selected:#1c3558; --ds-focus:#7db2ff; } } .ds-nav { display:grid; gap:4px; font:400 14px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { padding:8px 10px; border-radius:6px; color:var(--ds-muted); text-decoration:none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--ds-hover); color:var(--ds-ink); } .ds-nav-item[aria-current=page] { background:var(--ds-selected); color:var(--ds-ink); font-weight:500; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:3px solid var(--ds-focus); outline-offset:1px; }

components.description: One of at most three decision-relevant summaries.

components.css: :host { --ds-surface:#eef1f5; --ds-ink:#18212f; --ds-muted:#526071; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-surface:#232a34; --ds-ink:#edf2f7; --ds-muted:#b6c0cc; } } .ds-metric { display:grid; gap:5px; padding:20px; border-radius:14px; background:var(--ds-surface); color:var(--ds-ink); font-family:system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-metric-label,.ds-metric-note { color:var(--ds-muted); font-size:13px; } .ds-metric-value { font-size:28px; font-weight:500; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; }

components.name: Phase Allocation
components.description: A labeled part-to-whole bar for working-token allocation.
components.css: :host { --ds-ink:#18212f; --ds-track:#e5e9ef; } @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) { :host { --ds-ink:#edf2f7; --ds-track:#29313c; } } .ds-phase { display:grid; gap:10px; margin:0; color:var(--ds-ink); font:500 16px/1.3 system-ui,sans-serif; } .ds-phase-track { display:flex; height:14px; overflow:hidden; border-radius:999px; background:var(--ds-track); } .ds-phase-a { width:61%; background:#63aef2; } .ds-phase-b { width:15%; background:#f59e62; } .ds-phase-c { width:17%; background:#6fcf8c; } .ds-phase-d { width:7%; background:#9299a3; }

narrative.overview:
Hydra is a calm working surface for examining demanding Codex tasks. It should feel closer to a carefully arranged analyst's desk than to a monitoring wall: the current project and freshness are obvious, the most useful evidence is near at hand, and deeper records stay organized until requested.

The interface is information-dense without being compressed. A wide, mostly unframed workspace carries the task; tonal layers and dividers establish structure. Three headline summaries are the only repeated cards. Everything else uses navigation, tables, bars, and disclosure rather than decorative containers.

It explicitly rejects a generic SaaS KPI wall, a terminal or evidence dump, a neon observability control room, and AI-styled glass or gradient decoration.
keyCharacteristics: Evidence-first hierarchy with visible provenance and freshness.
Restrained neutrals with one interaction accent.
Wide desktop workspace with structural narrow-window adaptation.
Fast state transitions and no decorative choreography.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Verification Blue is limited to actions, current selection, focus, and links. Its scarcity is part of the hierarchy.

rules.name: The Data Color Rule
rules.body: Phase colors may color marks and swatches only. Labels and numeric values remain Ink.

rules.name: The Tabular Evidence Rule
rules.body: Numeric columns use tabular figures and end alignment so differences can be scanned without visual jitter.

rules.name: The Flat Desk Rule
rules.body: Resting surfaces never float. If a region looks like a detached marketing card, the hierarchy is wrong.

dos: Do show freshness, provenance, lower bounds, and caveats adjacent to the fact they qualify.
Do use exactly three headline metric summaries when those metrics are decision-relevant.
Do keep long task collections and evidence in quiet tables with progressive disclosure.
Do preserve system theme as the initial state and persist an explicit light or dark user choice.
Do use semantic HTML, visible focus, text alternatives, and color-independent labels.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS KPI wall made from interchangeable cards.
Don't present a terminal or evidence dump before its meaning.
Don't turn Hydra into a neon observability control room with decorative alerts and saturated color.
Don't use glass surfaces, gradient text, ornamental grids, oversized radii, or decorative motion.
Don't turn unavailable, lower-bound, or incomparable evidence into a confident score or conclusion.
Don't expose raw paths, prompts, commands, session identifiers, or tool output in browser-visible UI.
